tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the lead suit; trump beats non-trump, and the Ace is highest. The round winner picks the next round's trump — if that's you, you choose it; otherwise it is auto-set from their longest suit.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Click any card to select it. The hand shrinks by one card each round (Round 1 deals 7).
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. The player who plays the strongest card wins the trick.
tutorial.info: Each player starts with one Dogbone token. A player who wins zero tricks in a round must spend a Dogbone to survive; with no Dogbone left, a zero-trick round eliminates them (greyed out). The last player standing wins the match.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
